description: Compute a deterministic physical-horizon chronosense envelope for an agent turn at a UTC timestamp and Earth location, along with its compact plain-text header (`[CAELUS-CHRONO ...]`, zero astrological vocabulary), 10-D L2-normalized `photoperiodVector`, and unsupervised `phaseStratumKey` (`<horizon>:<season>:lon<0..5>`). Computes an 8-character canonical chart digest (`clockId`), explicit local solar-midnight `nightCrossed` flag, photoperiod-warped `daySlot` (`1..12` or `polar_day`/`polar_night`), separated horizon and deadline countdowns, and follow-the-sun `wavefrontQuadrant`. Pass the returned `envelope` directly to `audit_chronosense_cursor` to verify an agent's write-back cursor.

date.description: UTC ISO date-time for the current turn (convert from local first); omit for now

deadline_date.description: Optional active task deadline UTC ISO timestamp

deadline_label.description: Optional short label for the active deadline (default 'deadline')

elevation_m.description: Observer elevation above sea level in meters (default 0)

prev_date.description: Optional previous turn UTC ISO timestamp (computes nightCrossed and dtPrevMin)

name: chronosense_tick
